verdict.rationale: Foreloop's own docs describe the opposite workflow: a developer runs Claude Code/Codex 'in a checkout of your repository on your own machine,' meaning the human clones and sets up the repo before the agent operates, not the agent autonomously cloning/installing/configuring its environment (foreloop-docs-3). No evidence anywhere in the pack shows Foreloop provisioning a workspace, cloning the repo, or installing dependencies on the agent's behalf.
